name: Necromancer: a Permafrost proc lets Glacial Impact hit an unfrozen target (#4181)
contract: While the Permafrost buff is active the target counts as frozen, so Glacial Impact can be cast and deals damage. Glacial Impact 704355 and its damage spell 707592 are DmgClass 1 (magic) spells with their own hit rolls, so the level-60 caster gets spell hit rating: without it a same-level miss on either roll leaves the Permafrost cast with no damage, which is indistinguishable from a refused cast.

steps.label: Glacial Impact is refused on an unfrozen target without Permafrost
Glacial Impact hit the unfrozen target under Permafrost
